thought.text: I have gathered comprehensive evidence. Let me do one final check on the documented "KI-Analyse" workflow availability.

reasoning_content:
The non-ready are the completed seed jobs (gesetzesbegruendung-db, jura-db) — but those have has_ready_probe? They showed as "Completed -" — let me re-check. Actually the filter was `has_ready_probe&&is_ready!=="Ready"`. Those two seeds have ready probes but are completed (is_ready='-'), which is expected for completed jobs. So no anomaly.

All 33 running processes are fine, and the 5 completed seeds exited 0.

I have comprehensive evidence:

- Prereqs: uv 0.12.23, Node 24.11.1, pnpm 10.30.2, process-compose v1.122.0, Python 3.13.16.
- Docker infra: 11 containers running/healthy (postgres, temporal, keycloak, minio, qdrant, spicedb, oauth2-proxy, temporal-ui).
- Process-compose: 38 processes, 33 Running, 5 Completed exit 0, 0 failures.
- Backend APIs: /healthz 200 for all services; PLS returns seeded statuses/types.
- Frontend: vite dev server on 3002 serving HTML; oauth2-proxy on 3000 redirects to Keycloak; full OIDC login succeeds; authenticated API call through proxy returns 200.
- Seeds: project_logic status/type, FCS template categories/document types, AVD VAE template 159 nodes, gesetze-normen 2187 norms.
- Temporal: namespaces, task queue pollers registered.
- MinIO: buckets dms-local, quarantine-bucket, temporal-payloads.
- Qdrant: empty collections (expected for fresh install).
- Documented workflow: created a Verfahren successfully.

Limitations: External LLM (localhost:4000) and Docling (localhost:5001) are absent by design per guide ("The local stack does not start an LLM provider"). So the full KI-Analyse workflow can't run end-to-end without external providers, but the guide explicitly excludes these from the local stack. So it's not a failure.

The workaround: docker-compose.override.yaml replaces minio images, and .env S3 secret edited. These are documented in the summary. They don't constitute failure — the software operates.

Examination process had 21 restarts but is currently Running/Ready. This is from first-run readiness probe retries during migrations — consistent with summary. Not currently failing.

I'll mark success.

Let me just double-check the FCS "KI-Analyse starten" endpoint exists and Temporal workflow can be started — but external LLM/Docling absent means the workflow would fail at extraction. The guide explicitly says LLM/Docling are external, so this is expected. The core workflow's runtime components are present.

Actually, let me verify one more thing: is there any evidence the seeds are all fresh? All good.

Let me finalize with success.

One consideration: The guide says "Open the frontend at http://localhost:3000/app/". I verified this works through full OIDC. 

I'm confident: success.

Let me write the report.
